mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses equity discount rates, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as investors anticipate accommodative monetary policy.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month FEDFUNDS decline, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly unemployment rate exceeding 5.0% signals deteriorating labor market conditions that trigger immediate risk-off behavior, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with UNRATE > 5.0%, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate broad-based consumer demand contraction, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks escalate.
candidate_trigger: HOUST and RSAFS both decline in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Industrial production falling below 100 (index 2017=100) signals manufacturing contraction that leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as recession fears intensify.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with INDPRO < 100, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Core CPI exceeding 240.0 signals persistent inflation that prompts restrictive monetary policy, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of months with CPIAUCSL > 240.0, or Rank IC over 3 years falls below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A rising trend in housing starts over the past 3 months signals strengthening consumer confidence and economic activity, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 55% of periods with 3-month HOUST rise, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth and unemployment decline indicate labor market tightness that fuels wage inflation, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as policy tightening looms.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases and UNRATE decreases in the last month
failure_condition: SPX 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of instances with PAYEMS increase and UNRATE decrease, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.

mechanism_narrative: Federal funds rate above 2.0% with monthly increase signals restrictive monetary policy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as borrowing costs rise.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 55% of periods with FEDFUNDS > 2.0% and rising, or Rank IC over 5 years falls below 0.02.
